d: The crew gives a mild-mannered house a high-octane makeover, including a kitchen inspired by a racing pit stop crew.
A house is turned into an island paradise with huge bedrooms, a Tiki-inspired kitchen and a jungle for a backyard.
A stale bachelor pad gets a 1970s-inspired theme with a disco dance floor.
A motorcycle must be large enough that the entire crew can ride it at once.
Building a giant chopper over a two-week span with help and advice from Billy Lane and Arlen Ness. Host: Frank Payne.
Building the biggest claw game ever displayed at the San Diego County Fair, measuring nearly 19 feet high and weighing about 5,000 pounds.
Using a standard backyard charcoal barbecue grill as a model, the team builds a giant grill that stands 20 feet high, 20 feet wide and weighs 3,500 pounds.
The team builds the world's biggest hair clippers during a five-day span.
Frank's 12-foot cuckoo-clock is tested against a digital clock.
When Wardens respond to a call sometimes getting there is most of the battle.
A headless deer, a trophy bull elk being poached and an illegally tagged deer keep the Warden's busy.
Wardens catch one guy in a web of lies at a check station.
Warden Lesofski looks for those who left elk to rot. Region 2 Wardens get into a situation dealing with their decoy being shot.
The wardens hunt down a ruthless poacher.
"Thrill kill" poacher; a mother bear protecting her cubs; a dolphin is rescued.
A Marijuana Eradication Team work to capture Mexican cartel members who are growing marijuana on a remote mountain.
Chris and Casey Keefer get one last chance at an Alaskan moose.

Brothers Chris and Casey Keefer pore through video submissions before choosing a deserving duo to join them in Alaska; the hunters meet at the airport for the first time. Casey and Kaid are dropped, while Chris and company get hung up at the hangar.
The Alaskan weather relents long enough for Chris and Kaid to reach their destination, and land some food; Casey and R.L. set up camp the day before moose season.
A search for black beans and moose; a predator is spotted heading towards camp.
Lou faces the toughest loss of his career. Lou and Matt track a debtor to a junkyard, where everything changes.
Matt has an idea to keep the repo team in business; teens have a dark secret; a baker refuses to give up his car.
Lou has accepted Matt's offer to buy into the company; the team interrupts a kid's brunch party.

Matt contends with a duo of drunken debutantes; Froy and Sonia reclaim a vintage truck from an Oktoberfest enthusiast; Lou, Matt, and Froy head to the country to repo a Jeep from a gang of drunken teenagers.
A security car is repossessed; a race boat is claimed back from an extremely offensive owner; five cars are repossessed from a group of teens.
